issues.issue: Original printed CHAP CVII/editorial CVIII begins PDF568/printed534 below the preceding humours divider, continues PDF569-572 and top PDF573/printed539 before separate printed CVIII begins.
Book describes traditional astrology mind/behavior claims; none are clinically or psychometrically validated and none should be applied to a living person as factual traits.
Original ascendant-based principal significator is conditional on planets occupying rising or intercepted signs; sign intercept depends on house geometry and birth time.
Other planets having essential dignities at selected manners significator's degree also participate, creating a discretionary candidate set.
Benefic/malefic and strong/weak readings have different branches, with purported outward-versus-inward character differences; not a simple one-line planet label.
Mercury may inherit qualities of nearest conjunct or most dignified conjunct planet, which might disagree; numerical priority threshold unresolved.
Mercury without conjunction uses most essential dignity at its place, another possible planet.
North/south lunar node analogies to Jupiter/Saturn/Mars are historical symbolic assignments, not verified influences.
Sun and Moon in Ascendant are generally weak manners indicators unless unusually fortified; simple conjunction presence cannot be scored unconditionally.
Multiple Ascendant planets create varied behaviors and stronger traits supposedly last longer, without a measured strength scale.
Moon directions through terms/aspects supposedly change manners over time; need exact directed-time procedures before any frozen prospective test.

When no planet is in Ascendant, several overlapping fallbacks involving Moon, Mercury, their conjunction, Ascendant lord, dispositor aspects and essential dignities are allowed; source's precedence/ties cannot be guessed.
Source switches between ordinary aspects and 'partile' aspects for fallback, with an unspecified exact numerical orb.
Fixed-star claims often require proximity to manners significator or lord of ascendant, not a star in a horoscope regardless of contact.
First/second magnitude and near-ecliptic conditions need source-era magnitude catalog, ecliptic latitude and 1647 precessed star positions.

Descriptions of murder, violence, hypocrisy, sexuality, disability or mental illness in historical fixed-star examples are serious unsupported stereotyped accusations; must never be inferred about real people.
Fixed-star conditions include opposing claims depending on whether conjunct Moon, Ascendant ruler or Saturn/Mars/Mercury, allowing substantial retrospective reinterpretation.
Oculus Tauri/Girdle Orion/Spica/Algol and period names are historical sky labels; modern identification/degree equivalence must be independently authenticated.
Historical Caput Medusae claim explicitly contains death or violence and must not be presented as actual prognosis or dangerousness assessment.
With Mercury at Rictus the author allows both foolishness and acute understanding for the same contact, reducing falsifiability.
Spica is located in Libra in period source despite the 'Virgin' name; sign and degree should not be silently changed.
Johannes Angelus rising-degree stereotypes are treated by Lilly as too strict; source itself warns against excessive degree-specific categories.
Lilly nevertheless lists all twelve zodiac sign stereotypes; they are broad, contradictory and unvalidated, and cannot establish birth-chart predictive discrimination.
Earlier humoral temperament-derived personality labels overlap with this chapter's zodiac/planet statements, creating dependence between counted evidence families.
Negative source traits for Capricorn and Pisces involve sexuality, speech or moral character; no demographic person-specific inference is supported.
Author's assertion he has 'ever found true' is retrospective testimony without named cases, denominator, prospective scoring or negative reports.
Fixed-star predictions mentioning dates/risks such as violent death remain historically unverified and should not enter medical/forensic decisions.
Original images preserve text and precise star coordinates but do not constitute fully independent astronomical catalog parity or complete second diplomatic transcription.
Following printed CVIII/edit.CIX starts PDF573 and has a separate positive/negative planet traits table PDF574-575; do not import into CVII.
No independent human/personality tests, real people identity classification, empirical predictive validations or runtime score/model promotion in this source-only extraction.
